init_riegeli_reader: create a RiegeliBackendReader instance to read trajectory data from a given data directory
get_nth_step: retrieve the nth step data as a StepData object by its zero-based index offset
get_episode_info: get the start index and length of the nth episode with optional metadata included
decode_step_data: decode a serialized data tuple into a dm_env TimeStep wrapped in a StepData object
close_reader: close the RiegeliBackendReader and release the underlying reader resources
